t: Lazy tong riveter ideal for engineers, mechanics and maintenance technicians. Heavy duty carbon steel lattice and head designed for repetitive work. Powerful, high performance, 3-jaw gripping system enables use of tool with only one hand without any loss of efficiency. Built-in power reduction mechanism reduces the amount of effort required to install rivets compared to traditional riveting tools. Stems are captured as they are released from the riveter. Compatible with 2.4, 3.2, 4, 4.8 and 6.4 mm rivets. Suitable for use with heating, ventilation, air conditioning units, sheet metal and gutters. Easy to use. Supplied with interchangeable heads and spanner.
